# algosec_ace_threat_list_entry (Resource)

Owns one exact destination in an ACE custom threat list. Experimental: normalization and concurrent insertion semantics are unverified; use exact server spelling and one writer. Requires complete paginated visibility. All changes replace, temporarily removing the entry; do not use create_before_destroy. DELETE always includes the exact nonempty destination, never the whole list. No live acceptance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Use exact server destination spelling and exclusive ownership.
resource "algosec_ace_threat_list_entry" "exception" {
  threat_type = "domains"
  list_type   = "allow-list"
  destination = "example.invalid"
  description = "Approved example domain"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Entry description, including explicit empty string. Changes replace.
- `destination` (String) Exact nonempty destination; no normalization. Changes replace.
- `list_type` (String) Custom block-list or allow-list. Changes replace.
- `threat_type` (String) Threat type. Changes replace.

### Optional

- `severity` (String) Required low, medium, high or critical for block-list. Omit for allow-list. Changes replace.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID: v1.<base64url(threat_type)>.<base64url(list_type)>.<base64url(destination)>, unpadded.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# v1 + unpadded base64url of domains, allow-list, example.invalid
terraform import algosec_ace_threat_list_entry.exception v1.ZG9tYWlucw.YWxsb3ctbGlzdA.ZXhhbXBsZS5pbnZhbGlk
```
